cites.x: My core argument is that "endless growth = good" is an ideological problem, and it requires an ideological solution.
In the simplest analysis, overpopulation of "too successful" species leads to pandemics that wipe them out. Hardly a stretched metaphor. [1] [link]

cites.stt: Popular strategies for reducing gasoline use aren't getting a chance to work
cites.x: This "systems phenomenon" — where governments are mostly constrained to act against our ecologically-enlightened self-interest — is brilliantly described by the lead author of Limits to Growth. [link]
